concepts.title: Butcher Personal Monopoly 3C Framework — Competence, Curiosity, Character
concepts.excerpt: Jack Butcher draws a Venn diagram. Three overlapping circles: Competence on the bottom left, Curiosity on the right, Character on top.

concepts.title: Perell Paradox of Specificity
concepts.excerpt: In 1977, a security guard at the Stokely Van Camp pork-and-beans factory in Kansas published a book.

concepts.title: Perell Personal Monopoly Cues and the Three-Pinch Rule
concepts.excerpt: David Perell takes Butcher's 3C framework and adds two operational protocols: the Personal Monopoly Cues (the criteria a position must satisfy) and the Three-Pinch Rule (the zoom-in procedure for finding the position).

concepts.title: Butcher DICE — Collect, Connect, Iterate, Emerge
concepts.excerpt: Steve Jobs said it at Stanford: you can't connect the dots looking forward; you can only connect them looking backwards.

concepts.title: Perell Irrationally Passionate and Patient — The 10-Year Horizon
concepts.excerpt: Perell shows a video of an entrepreneur giving advice in 30 seconds.

concepts.title: Perell Three Equity Options — Start, Evangelize, Invest
concepts.excerpt: Perell maps the equity-portfolio choices available to someone who has built a personal monopoly: what are the different ways to actually have equity in a business because once you own a business that is when there's real opportunities here to become that citizen of the internet...

concepts.title: Perell Create Not Find a Niche
concepts.excerpt: Perell tells the story of Eric Lewis. New York. Pianist. He didn't find a niche, he created one.

concepts.title: Perell Niche as Lens Not Topic
concepts.excerpt: Anna Fabrega is in a Q&A. Someone asks how to know if going deep into a niche will pay off.

concepts.title: Butcher Single Decision Eliminates a Thousand — Rules Amplify Creativity
concepts.excerpt: Jack Butcher worked in creative agencies.

concepts.excerpt: In 2021, Elon Musk responded to a tweet criticizing Tesla's valuation as too high given their manufacturing numbers.

concepts.title: Perell Content Triangle — Conversation to Article
concepts.excerpt: Henry David Thoreau went to Walden Pond for two years to write Walden.

concepts.title: Butcher Iterators Beat Perfectionists — Non-Monotonic Growth
